95: 
96: ```tsx
97: import { isTauri } from '@tauri-apps/api/core'
98: import { getCurrentWindow, type Window as TauriWindow } from '@tauri-apps/api/window'

100: const appWindow: TauriWindow | null = isTauri() ? getCurrentWindow() : null
101: ```
102: 
103: and wrap `platform()` in a try/catch as well. Controls then render only when
104: `isTauri()` is true; the optional-chained `appWindow?.minimize()` calls are inert on
105: web. This is what lets one bundle serve both targets — but it is a safety net for the
106: *component*, not a substitute for the **surface decision** at the top of this skill.
107: 
108: ### 5. Accessibility
109: 
110: Removing OS chrome removes OS-provided accessibility. You must replace it:
111: 
112: - `aria-label` on every control ("Close", "Minimize", "Maximize") — an icon-only or
113:   bare-color button is unlabeled to a screen reader.
114: - Controls must be real `<button>`s: keyboard-reachable and activatable.
115: - `select-none` on the bar so dragging never starts a text selection.
116: - Keep hover/active states visible — the OS gave these for free; now you owe them.
117: - Meet contrast on the bar's foreground against its own background, not the page's.
118: 
119: Run the `a11y-gate` skill over the result like any other UI.
120: 
121: ## Reference implementation
122: 
123: The scaffolded `desktop/src/shared/components/Titlebar.tsx` is the worked example:
124: `isTauri()`-gated window resolution, macOS/Windows control variants, explicit
125: `startDragging()`, aria-labeled controls, brand lockup centered via flex spacers
126: that are draggable because of the explicit call. Read it before writing a new one —
127: and prefer adapting it over starting from scratch (Rule 2, Rule 3).
128: 
129: ## Checklist
130: 
131: - [ ] Surface decided deliberately — desktop only; web/mobile got their own answer
132: - [ ] `decorations: false` set **and** a title bar component actually exists
133: - [ ] Control order correct per platform (macOS left / Windows-Linux right)
134: - [ ] `data-tauri-drag-region` **and** `startDragging()` on left-button mousedown
135: - [ ] All Tauri API access gated behind `isTauri()` — web bundle does not throw
136: - [ ] Every control has an `aria-label` and is a focusable `<button>`
137: - [ ] Minimize, maximize/restore, close, and drag all verified by hand in a real window
